examples.name: data-sync
examples.summary: One host.sync.create call registers a CSV URL as a scheduled mirror into a host table; get, list and delete read it back.
examples.title: Data sync: mirror a CSV into a table

examples.name: database-in-a-minute
examples.summary: Create a table, load fixture.csv, and ask equality, range, count, GROUP BY and LIKE questions as plain SQL.
examples.title: A database in one minute

examples.name: docs-qa
examples.summary: Put and index an 8-document corpus, publish ask_docs, and ask six gold questions; five of six must hit.
examples.title: Docs Q&A in a minute

examples.name: file-share
examples.summary: Put a blob with a ttl, hand out its signed URL, and let retention expire and prune it without a cleanup job.
examples.title: Share a file that expires on its own

examples.name: first-run
examples.summary: Sign up, publish table_note as a python tool that appends through mcphost.table, call it, and read back the real output.
examples.title: First run: publish a tool and call it

examples.name: retrieval
examples.summary: Index documents, table columns and urls under one name; re-put a document and watch behind_by go 1 then 0 as the index follows.
examples.title: Retrieval that follows its sources

examples.name: scheduled-job-receipts
examples.summary: Schedule a tool, fire it, and read one host.schedule_receipts call: rows, failure streak and next fire time.
examples.title: Scheduled job receipts

examples.name: share-a-tool
examples.summary: Publish an http tool that injects a secret, share it to a group, and let a teammate call it without ever seeing the key.
examples.title: Share a tool, not a key

examples.name: team-memory
examples.summary: Publish remember, recall and forget as python tools over a shared table, share them to a group, and revoke a teammate.
examples.title: One memory for all your agents

examples.name: uptime-probes
examples.summary: Publish a scheduled probe and a status tool; a 503 target is marked down with down_since, a healthy one shows 100%.
examples.title: Uptime probes with no server

examples.name: webhook-inbox
examples.summary: One host.webhook_inbox.create call returns a signed URL; a curl to it shows up in host.tool_call and host.msg.wait.
examples.title: Webhook inbox in one call
